subject.title: fix(codex): prefer recovered replies over stale failure banners

question: Should a failed Codex turn be allowed to resolve from streamed deltas alone, or only from completed assistant-message evidence?
rationale: The PR intentionally treats delta-only failed turns as recovered, but Codex source shows deltas are progress before item completion, so accepting them changes user-visible error delivery semantics.

options.title: Require Completed Assistant Evidence
options.body: Suppress failed-turn errors only when `item/completed` or completed turn-item assistant text proves a final answer exists.

options.title: Accept Partial Delta Delivery
options.body: Allow partial streamed deltas to replace failure banners, accepting the risk of incomplete replies when a fatal error interrupts the turn.

options.title: Pause For Codex Contract
options.body: Wait for a clearer upstream recovered-versus-fatal signal before changing OpenClaw's failed-turn delivery policy.

recommendation.title: Require Completed Assistant Evidence
recommendation.body: Suppress failed-turn errors only when `item/completed` or completed turn-item assistant text proves a final answer exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties this account most directly to the Codex app-server bridge and collector path.
